feedback.percent_too_easy: Set 1 #38 (price +20% then -20%) gave the 240 intermediate step, which removed the work. Real test (ISEE Lower #4 #38) gives no intermediate value and asks for percent increase/decrease. Use no-intermediate, net-percent-change framing in later sets.
feedback.diagrams: Labeled diagrams are fine (real tests label dimensions). Similar-figure and cut-out problems should show labels and mark the cut on the figure. Diagrams that only restate the setup make the problem too easy (e.g. 8 ft by 3 ft).
feedback.median_mean: Median/mean belong to Math Achievement, not QR. Keep them out of QR sets; put them in MA sets.
feedback.not_overuse: NOT-type equivalence drills appeared 4 times in set 1 and she got those right; limit to 1 per set.
